_documentation: Rotation state for the weekly member spotlight on the home page (issue #341). Written weekly by scripts/rotate-spotlight.py and read at runtime by assets/js/home-spotlight.js. The block stays DORMANT (hidden) until at least `minEligible` members are eligible (a member is eligible when they have both a photo and a written bio). `current` is the member id featured this week (null when dormant); `history` is the recent rotation, newest first; `pinned` is an optional member id the maintainer can set to feature next run regardless of the score (the script consumes it). `weights` tunes the balanced-rotation score: early-career boost, senior (professor) penalty, ITC-country boost, Working-Group-balance boost, and how many recent features to hold out. Gender is deliberately not scored: the maintainer corrects any imbalance via `pinned`. Do not hand-edit `current`/`history`/`active`; let the script manage them. Setting `pinned` by hand is the supported manual override.
